title: OpenAI's revenue is reportedly $20 billion less than previously projected | TechCrunch
summary: The Financial Times reports that the company has told investors that its annualized revenue is “approaching $50 billion.” The $70 billion figure was previously reported by news outlets and based on information that had been shared with OpenAI investors, the outlet writes.
